financial_question: Can domestic Chinese commodity night sessions supply a reproducible, causal measure of China-specific information generated after the A-share close and before the next equity open?

predefined_products.economic_role: China steel-chain and imported raw-material demand

source_audit_sample.reason: fixed liquid-cycle contract sample for transport-source auditing only; chosen before any CSI1000 target metric and not used to select a forecasting symbol

SHFE.fact: CU continuous trading historically starts at 21:00 and ends at 01:00 next day; day trading includes 09:00-10:15, 10:30-11:30, 13:30-15:00
RB continuous trading launched from late 2014 with a 21:00 start; historical close initially 01:00, with later official product-time tables recording 23:00
official SHFE product-time table defines a trading day from the preceding workday continuous session through the current day session

DCE.fact: DCE 2015 monthly report states the night session for night-traded products changed from 21:00-02:30 to 21:00-23:30 from the 2015-05-11 trading session, and explicitly discusses iron ore as benefiting from night trading
DCE 2019 monthly report records the night-session close changing from 23:30 to 23:00 effective from 2019-03-29 21:00
current DCE trading-hours material records Session 1 21:00-23:00 and defines a trading day as night plus day sessions
official DCE iron-ore manual identifies ticker I and the iron-ore futures contract

gate_1_provenance: every consumed third-party file path and Git blob SHA is frozen
only files needed for dates through 2020 are fetched
parsed output contains zero post-2020 market rows
gate_2_schema: OHLC are finite and satisfy low <= open/close <= high
volume and open_interest are nonnegative when reported
no duplicate contract-datetime rows after exact duplicate accounting
gate_3_clock: observed bar timestamps are consistent with the official product session regime applicable at that date
night bars are assigned to the following exchange trading day rather than to a convenient calendar-day return
holiday-eve no-night-session rules are not silently forward-filled
DCE iron-ore historical clock changes 02:30 -> 23:30 -> 23:00 are handled by date regime rather than applying one current clock to all history
gate_4_official_price_crosscheck: for each predefined product, compare a frozen sample of contract-day OHLC aggregates against an official exchange daily/settlement source
price scale and direction must agree exactly or within an explicitly recorded exchange-rounding tolerance
any unexplained material mismatch invalidates the transport source for that product
gate_5_causal_contract_selection_design: before any CSI1000 target metric is read, separately freeze how the night-session contract is selected using information available by previous China 15:00
future full-day volume/open-interest ranking is forbidden
continuous-contract back-adjustment across the overnight interval is forbidden

model_boundary.if_all_source_gates_pass: a separate domestic-night feature/model preregistration may be created
model_boundary.if_any_source_gate_fails: invalidate the affected product or whole transport source according to the frozen audit; do not substitute a new product after target results
